name: Pork Chops & Sweet Potato Mash with Citrus Baby Greens Salad
ingredients: 8 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Wash and medium dice sweet potatoes (without peeling). Place in a medium saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Cook until tender, 10-15 minutes.
Heat broiler and position rack about 6 inches from the top.
Place pork chops in a baking dish. Rub with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Place in the oven and broil until pork is cooked through, 7-9 minutes per side.
Wash and dry greens. Transfer to a medium bowl.

Slice off top and bottom from oranges, then cut off the skin and white pith from the sides so you can see the orange flesh. Cut in between the membranes to release the segments and add to bowl with greens.
Add cranberries to bowl with greens and orange.
In a small bowl, prepare salad dressing by whisking together olive oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
Drain potatoes and return to saucepan. Add broth, olive oil, garlic, salt, and pepper; mash until smooth.
Serve pork with mash and salad on the side. Drizzle dressing over salad and enjoy!
author: Mealime
